applied.quote: UTMA and UGMA accounts are taxed the same way, and the income belongs to the child, reported under the child's Social Security number.

applied.quote: Parents can instead report a child's interest and dividend income on their own return with [Form 8814](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i8814.pdf) if the child meets the conditions, though the election can cost up to $135 more than a separate return.
applied.replacement: Parents can instead report a child's interest and dividend income on their own return with [Form 8814](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i8814.pdf) if the child meets the conditions, though with qualified dividends or capital gain distributions the election can cost up to $135 more than a separate return.
applied.why: SOURCE ties the $135 extra cost to qualified dividends/capital gain distributions.
